tech.trend: Trading below the whole moving-average stack, under a flat 200-day; fresh death-cross
tech.summary: The price closed 2.54 below a falling 20-day (2.63), a falling 50-day (2.77) and a flat 200-day (2.78). Momentum is soft: RSI(14) is ~34 and the daily ATR near 0.06 (~2.4%) points to a normal tape. MACD (12·26·9) is below zero but turning up (−0.06 / −0.06 / +0.00). The 50-day crossed beneath the 200-day 1 session ago — a fresh death-cross, a momentum-regime change rather than noise inside an intact trend. Over the last year it has ranged 2.35–3.85; the last close sits 34% below that high and 8% above that low.
tech.bull: A daily close back above 2.59 would clear the nearest resistance and open the 2.74 zone.
tech.bear: A close below 2.45 would break the nearest support and open the 2.25 zone.
